headline: Review and approval of policy recommendations for Section I and Section J.
summary: The Policy Subcommittee will review and approve recommended changes to Section I and Section J policies. The meeting also includes time for public participation and other subcommittee business.
items: Review and Approval of Recommendations for Section I (with Changes, Clean)
Review and Approval of Recommendations for Section J (Analysis, with changes)
